{{Quote|Jesmin and I found the civilian exit from the Black Crest Mountain mines. It wasn't at the site of the old mine exit, which really is all sealed over. It’s a few hundred meters farther into the city, in an army-surplus business and warehouse. It's on the plaza surrounding Old Kura Courthouse Square.|Bhindi Drayson and Jesmin Tainer|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Major Saving's Army Surplus''' was a building located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]. It was near the [[Old Kura City Courthouse Plaza]] and was the civilian exit of the hidden [[Pop-Dogs]] base in the [[Black Crest Mountain]] mines.<ref name="MK" />
